**Summary:** Nonthaburi has exactly two 1-star Michelin restaurants in the 2026 Guide, both in Pak Kret district (~35 min from central Bangkok):

- **[AKKEE](https://www.akkeerestaurant.com/)** — contemporary tasting counter; chef Sittikorn "Ou" Chantop (2025 Michelin Young Chef Award winner) revives Eastern-coast Thai recipes from antique cookbooks; set menu ฿2,150, dinner-only Tue–Sun, open until 11 PM Saturdays; book online.
- **[Suan Thip](https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/nonthaburi-region/nonthaburi/restaurant/suan-thip)** — refined Royal Thai in riverside pavilions and lotus ponds; starred since 2019; moderate prices, no alcohol, daily 11 AM–9 PM; book by phone.
